name: Small funds

subjectOf.text: Strategic adjustment to registration is a function of firm size: firms that planned a strategic response to Dodd-Frank were smaller than firms that did not.
subjectOf.abstract: Firms that planned a strategic response were smaller than those firms that did not plan a strategic response.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hedge Fund Manager Registration Under the Dodd-Frank Act (2012). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2150377
scope_conditions: survey respondents, n=94, comparing the twenty-four advisers planning a strategic response with the sixty-two who did not

subjectOf.text: Smaller private funds spend more on compliance than larger ones, both as a share of AUM and relative to operating costs, which means increasing regulatory scrutiny falls disproportionately on smaller funds.
subjectOf.abstract: Smaller private funds spend more on compliance costs than their larger counterparts—both as a percentage of AUM and in relation to oper- ating costs; this suggests that increasing regulatory scrutiny disproportionately impacts smaller funds.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Post Dodd-Frank Act Evolution of the Private Fund Industry Comparative Evidence from 2012 and 2 (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2739479
scope_conditions: private fund advisers subject to Dodd-Frank compliance obligations
compliance measured as share of AUM and of operating costs

subjectOf.text: Barriers to entry for small firms are becoming an increasing problem in the private fund industry under the evolving post-Dodd-Frank legal environment, with references to such barriers rising from 24 percent of respondents in 2012 to 33 percent in 2015.
subjectOf.abstract: The 2015 survey responses suggest that barriers to entry for small firms are becoming increasingly a problem for the private fund industry in the continuously evolving post-Dodd-Frank-Act legal environment.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Post Dodd-Frank Act Evolution of the Private Fund Industry Comparative Evidence from 2012 and 2 (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2739479
scope_conditions: 2012 and 2015 survey responses about the next five years
